Please refer to the attached document for the scope of work and equipment details. 1. Scope of Works The proposed works shall include, but not be limited to: Supply of three (3) new cranking gearboxes, Model 41022, or suitable compatible replacements. Provision of all necessary manpower, tools and equipment. Dismantling and removal of the affected operable wall panels. Transportation of the affected panels to the workshop or factory, if required. Removal of existing damaged gearboxes and installation of new replacement units. Reinstatement of surface boards and laminate finishes to match the existing appearance as closely as possible. Transportation and reinstallation of the repaired operable wall panels on-site. Testing and commissioning to ensure smooth and proper operation of the operable wall systems. Removal and proper disposal of damaged components. 3. Quotation Requirements Kindly include the following information in your quotation: Itemised cost breakdown for each affected panel. Cost of replacement gearboxes, labour and transportation. Estimated lead time for replacement parts. Estimated duration required to complete the works. Warranty period for replacement parts and workmanship. Quotation validity and payment terms. Any additional charges or exclusions, if applicable. Please also indicate whether the replacement works can be carried out on-site or whether the affected panels must be transported to your workshop. As the classrooms are regularly used for mosque programmes and activities, we would appreciate your proposed work schedule to minimise disruption to our daily operations.
